evidence.title: Installed dispatch skill
evidence.finding: The product-supplied slash-command skill registers a run, reads its YAML workflow and delegates orchestration to the installed main-coordinator prompt.

evidence.title: Installed main-coordinator workflow
evidence.locator: Dispatching Sub-Coordinators; report/ingest; Model Selection; Status Tracking
evidence.finding: The main prompt routes phases to native Claude Code agents, selects role/model, reads returned reports and reports results to the local dashboard. This is instruction-driven orchestration inside the user's Claude Code session.
